details: Fresh US Consumer Price Index (CPI) and Producer Price Index (PPI) data for June showed inflation cooling more than expected. This development has reduced the likelihood of aggressive Federal Reserve interest rate hikes, positively impacting risk assets. Bitcoin surged above $65,000, and Ethereum also experienced significant gains, reflecting improved market sentiment. While some analysts note the rally is partly driven by short covering, the overall sentiment in the crypto market has improved due to the disinflationary signs.
title: US Inflation Cools, Boosting Bitcoin Above $65,000

details: The United States and the United Kingdom have introduced a collaborative roadmap aimed at aligning their regulatory approaches for stablecoins and tokenized assets across both jurisdictions. This initiative seeks to foster innovation while ensuring stability and integrity within the digital asset ecosystem.
title: US, UK Unveil Joint Roadmap for Crypto Regulatory Alignment

details: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh has stated that the central bank has no intention of bailing out the cryptocurrency industry in the event of financial difficulties. This reiterates a long-standing stance, emphasizing that the Fed aims to avoid intervening in crypto market failures. Despite these comments, major cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and XRP saw price rallies.
title: Fed Chair Warsh Reiterates No Bailouts for Crypto Industry
